description: What a deck list is, for building: every row with its card facts (type, mana cost, mana value, colour identity, section, is_commander, is_companion), the mana curve of nonland cards (last bucket 7+), cards per type, coloured mana symbols against lands per colour, opening-hand land odds (exactly 0…7 lands in seven; two_to_four_lands), land_drops (a land every turn through turns 1…6, going first and second), and format legality. All figures are over the LIBRARY: the main deck without the commander(s) and without the sideboard. Probabilities are 0…1, hypergeometric — no mulligans, tutors or card draw; say so when quoting them. Optional `odds`: the chance of holding at least `want` (default 1) of a group of cards by `turn` (0 = the opening seven). Name the group by `cards` (names in the list) or by `type` (Land, Creature, …); on_the_play:true skips the first draw (two-player, going first). Reads the list only: it says nothing about which copies you own — use deck_status for that.

cards.description: Card names in the list, counted together

name: deck_stats

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

is_companion.description: The deck's companion: a sideboard row, outside the library

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

code.description: `proxies` is the warning that the list holds proxies: always relay it. On a casual deck it says the deck is not tournament legal; on a tournament deck, that its proxies count as missing

legal.description: The list against its format's rules. Proxies never affect it: the proxies warning says what they cost

probability.description: 0–1, hypergeometric: no mulligans, tutors or card draw. Say so.

land_colors.description: Lands whose colour identity includes the colour: an estimate

library.description: Cards drawn from: the main deck without the commander(s) and the sideboard

title: Deck stats
